He is a founding vice-chair of the CLIF Consortium and serves as President of the CLIF Foundation.

A founding vice-chair of the CLIF Consortium, he serves as Secretary of the CLIF Foundation.

He is the founding executive director of the CLIF Consortium and serves as Treasurer of the CLIF Foundation.

He leads new member integration as a CLIF Consortium vice-chair and serves on the CLIF Foundation Board of Directors.

bio: Siva Bhavani is a pulmonary and critical care physician-scientist at Emory University. His research develops artificial intelligence methods that use vital signs and other clinical data to study individualized treatment in critical illness. His work also examines how these methods perform in clinical settings and how electronic health records can support more accurate physiologic measurements. He is a CLIF Consortium steering committee member and serves on the CLIF Foundation Board of Directors.
